title: icon bar: CFG text lower on a larger button without border; no fold animation with the raytracer
author: Claude-JG
description: CFG0 ... is written lower, the underlay rectangle is slightly larger and has no border; with the raytracer the bar also fades in, but a raytraced frame is slow, so the bar shall show completely without delay in that case.
releaseNotes: The CFG buttons of the icon bar are larger, without border, with CFG0 ... written lower; with the raytracer the bar appears at once (revision2026c step RG6.19.10)
